meta.headline_text: Composio already ships 16 of the 25 apps researched so far. Of the 9 it doesn't, 3 look buildable now.
meta.lede_text: Pilot run: 25 of 100 apps researched by the agent (Gemini + Composio search) with link and auth-oracle checks. The grounded re-ask, second-model diff and human-graded accuracy sample run next, so treat values as unverified.

patterns.headline: App review is the real gate, not auth
Free to read, paid to call
Every customer has a different host
GraphQL-only: easy auth, hard tool shapes
Not APIs at all: local toolkits
Close to no public developer surface

weights: self-serve key 3 / trial 2 / app review or paid plan 1 / partner, sales or none 0
free tier or sandbox 2 / trial 1 / none 0
